name: Turtle Collection | Set of 4 | 250 ml each | Upcycled from Clear Wine & Vodka Bottles
shortStory: Inspired by sea turtles, symbols of renewal and ocean conservation, O.U.A.T.’s Turtle Collection transforms rescued clear glass bottles collected across Goa into thoughtfully handcrafted drinking glasses.
description: Inspired by sea turtles, symbols of renewal and ocean conservation, O.U.A.T.’s Turtle Collection transforms rescued clear glass bottles collected across Goa into thoughtfully handcrafted drinking glasses.

note.title: A Note on Uniqueness
note.content: Each glass is handcrafted from reclaimed clear bottles, so slight variations in shape, thickness and finish are natural and make every piece unique.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Material: Upcycled clear glass from reclaimed gin and wine bottles
• Capacity: 250 ml / 8.45 oz per glass | Height: 9 cm
• Design: Turtle artwork created using an acid-free sandblasting technique
• Versatile Use: Ideal for cocktails, whiskey, juices, iced coffee, water and other cold beverages
• Reusable: Designed for everyday use
• Category: Glassware
• Net Weight: 1,300 g per set
• Dimensions: 40 × 12 × 12 cm (set dimensions)
• Shipping: Dispatched within 2–3 working days

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Handwash with mild dishwashing liquid and a soft sponge or cloth.
• Avoid harsh abrasives, steel scrubbers and strong chemical cleaners to preserve the artwork.
• Handle with care and avoid sudden temperature changes, thermal shock and impact.
• Suitable for cold and room-temperature beverages. Avoid hot beverages.
• Do not use if cracked or chipped.
